dle_about_credits: Onyx Quill by Miinthe, built on DeepLore by pixelnull · Licensed under MIT · Icons by Flaticon
dle_about_description: AI-powered Obsidian vault lorebook for SillyTavern with keyword and semantic search.
dle_about_diagnostics_note: Export a self-contained diagnostic report to share when reporting bugs. The file is anonymized (API keys, IP addresses, hostnames, user paths are pseudonymized) and is designed to be readable by a flagship LLM for self-service triage. You're encouraged to verify the file before sharing.
dle_about_i18n_note: Note: this release greatly expanded translation coverage, but some runtime-rendered strings (empty-state hints, notifications, popup messages) are still in English. Localization continues in upcoming releases — contributions welcome on GitHub.
dle_about_master_enable_tooltip: Master on/off switch. When disabled, no entries are matched, no AI calls are made, and no prompts are injected.
dle_about_token_estimation_note: Token counts shown throughout Onyx Quill (budget bars, entry sizes, injection totals) are estimates based on ~4 characters per token. This is accurate for typical English text but may undercount for non-Latin scripts, code blocks, or highly punctuated content. For precise counts, consult your API provider's tokenizer.
dle_about_troubleshooting_note: Re-run the guided setup wizard, or reset settings to defaults. Vault connections and AI connection profiles are preserved in both cases.

dle_wi_em_handling_tooltip: How WI 'Example Messages' positions (before_example_messages / after_example_messages) are converted. Onyx Quill has no EM slot, so 'Append' makes them regular vault entries with a '## Example Dialogue' subheader; 'Skip' drops them entirely. Per-import override available from the post-import popup.
dle_wi_import_report_em_explainer:
SillyTavern's "Example Messages" slot is a special prompt position for sample dialogue lines that ride alongside the example messages already in your chat. Onyx Quill doesn't have that slot — by default we tuck these entries' content under a "## Example Dialogue" subheader inside the entry body, so they still reach the model when the entry triggers.

Honestly, one short flavor quote inside a character entry is usually enough to teach an LLM the voice. If you'd rather skip them on future imports, the button below flips the setting permanently (until you change it back in Settings → Onyx Quill → Matching → Import → WI Example Messages on import). Entries already imported stay in the vault — /oq-delete them by name if you want them gone.
dle_wi_import_report_em_skip_button: Always skip Example Messages on import (reversible in settings)
dle_wi_import_report_em_skip_done: Done — Example Messages will be skipped on future imports. Revert in Settings → Onyx Quill → Matching → Import.
dle_wi_import_report_roundtrip_explainer: Safe to ignore — Onyx Quill doesn't use these. They land in vault frontmatter so you can see what SillyTavern had configured. Remove the lines only if your Markdown feels cluttered. Run /oq-lint to find which entries carry them.
